adjudication.rationale: The diff does add a PUT /admin/customize/embedding route (config/routes.rb) and Admin::EmbeddingController#update (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb) that simply re-renders the embedding serializer without persisting anything. The client-side controller action saveChanges() calls this.get('embedding').update({}) (app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6), which would produce a successful response even though no state is changed server-side. However, the provided admin template (app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/embedding.hbs) doesn’t invoke saveChanges or expose editable embedding-level fields; hosts are actually persisted via EmbeddableHost#save through Admin::EmbeddableHostsController. So this is best characterized as dead/misleading API/UI plumbing rather than a demonstrable broken feature from the diff alone. The unused locale key admin.embedding.edit also appears accurate but is non-functional.
